Good to know

Skin Care for Indian Skin

Why Indian skin needs special care
Brown skin has more active pigment cells, so it can darken after irritation, heat or the wrong laser. That's why we choose technologies and settings carefully, and prepare your skin before stronger treatments.
Sunscreen is non-negotiable
Kerala's strong sun can undo results and trigger new pigmentation. Daily SPF 30 or higher, reapplied outdoors, protects your investment.
Humidity, sweat and breakouts
Heat and humidity increase oil and clogged pores. Lightweight skincare and regular deep cleansing help keep breakouts down.
Patience pays off
Most skin concerns improve over a course of sessions. Results build gradually and last longer with good aftercare.

Common problems

Problems We Solve Every Day

Tap a problem that sounds like yours.

"I've tried every face wash and cream."
Over-the-counter products work on the surface. Medical treatments reach deeper and target the cause, whether that's oil, pigment or collagen loss.
"My acne has gone but the marks haven't."
Dark marks and pitted scars need different treatments. Peels and Pico help marks, while CO2 laser and microneedling rebuild scars.
"My pigmentation got worse after a facial."
Harsh treatments can trigger pigment on Indian skin. We use gentle, controlled methods and always prepare the skin first.
"I want glowing skin for a wedding."
Start 6 to 8 weeks before. A plan of HydraFacial, peels or exosomes timed right gives your best skin on the day.
"I'm scared of lasers."
Modern lasers are precise and comfortable, with numbing and careful settings. We'll explain everything and start gently.

Questions

Skin Treatment FAQs

Which skin treatment is best for me?
It depends on your skin concern, skin type and how much downtime you can take. Our dermatologists examine your skin first and recommend the right treatment, or combination, for you. Use the concern matcher above for a quick guide.
What skin treatments does Facelit offer?
We offer chemical peels, CO2 fractional laser, PICO 450 laser, HydraFacial, microneedling and exosome skin treatment, plus anti-ageing treatments like Botox, fillers, Profhilo and HIFU.
Are laser treatments safe for Indian skin?
Yes, when the right laser and settings are used by experienced doctors. Indian skin is more prone to pigmentation, so we use technologies like picosecond and fractional lasers with careful settings and strict aftercare.
What is the best treatment for acne scars?
Most acne scars respond best to a combination, often CO2 fractional laser or microneedling, sometimes with exosomes or PRP. The best plan depends on your scar type.
What is the best treatment for pigmentation and melasma?
PICO laser toning and medical-grade chemical peels work well for many types of pigmentation, alongside prescribed creams and daily sunscreen. Melasma needs a gentle, long-term plan.
Which treatment has no downtime?
HydraFacial has no downtime. Pico toning and exosome treatment usually have little or none. Peels, microneedling and CO2 laser can involve a few days of redness or peeling.
How many sessions will I need?
It varies by treatment and concern. HydraFacial is often monthly, peels and microneedling usually 3 to 6 sessions, and laser treatments 2 to 8 sessions. Your doctor will give you a clear plan.
Can I combine skin treatments?
Yes. Combining treatments, like microneedling with exosomes, or Pico laser with peels, often gives better results. Your doctor will plan the order and timing.
Do I need a consultation first?
Yes. Every treatment starts with a skin assessment so we can choose the right option and settings for your skin type and concern.
What should I do after a skin treatment?
Follow your aftercare plan: gentle skincare, no harsh actives for a few days, and daily sunscreen. Sun protection is the most important step for Indian skin.
Where can I get skin treatments in Kerala?
Facelit has skin clinics in Trivandrum (Kowdiar), Karunagappally (Kollam) and Guruvayur (Thrissur). Some technologies are available at selected branches, so contact us to check.
How much do skin treatments cost?
Costs depend on the treatment, area and number of sessions. Book a consultation for a clear, personalised quote.
